answer_1.quote: Large Language Models (LLMs) have exhibited remarkable performance in various NLP tasks and applications.
answer_1.outputs: generated text continuations in response to toxic and non-toxic prompts

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the toxicity of model outputs with PerspectiveAPI and apply Perplexity (PPL) as well as semantic similarity (SIM) to reflect the coherence and the input-output semantic consistency, respectively.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation to reflect the coherence and consistency of the generated text.
answer_4.guideline: Each comparison pair contains one prompt and two corresponding outputs generated from two different models. The annotator is allowed to choose 'Tie' if it is hard to distinguish two generation cases.
